Waaree Solar Americas Secures 236 MW U.S. Solar Module Contract

Waaree Solar Americas has announced a significant expansion of its U.S. order book through a new contract. The agreement is for the supply of 236 MW of utility-scale solar modules. This development marks a notable step for the company in the American renewable energy market.
